decision_before_forced_data: Use the existing causal 18 ms delayed six-axis force estimate, not R10 raw residual, and measure only the world horizontal force vector. Average first, then take its magnitude. Reject if a normal-bound channel cannot resolve weak collision from real return motion. No online table force, future sensor, force/clock pattern, contact id or test labels.
mechanical_basis: Nominal inverse dynamics and inverse JTS filtering remove much of the commanded dynamics. Gravity/table normal do not have a world-horizontal force; remaining friction, dynamic load-model errors and estimator noise bound the identifiable force. A positive-mass grasp can create more tangential nuisance than an empty arm.
temporal_rule: Average the last 12 valid estimated horizontal force samples; require three successive exceedances to set and eight clear below 80% of the limit to unset. Clear witness when the synchronized finite support window changes. Keep original base detector active at all samples.
bound: No impact labels. Use 1.05 times the largest per-trial normal statistic for (unloaded, 0-1 kg, 1-4 kg, 4-8 kg) during the entire valid trajectory, never specific task-clock samples. Training masses are sampled at midpoints and boundaries; zero payload always classed as unloaded, irrespective of grip. Outside declared mass span use no auxiliary evidence.
run_order: exposed R21 weak set; not blind
outcome: Only contribute to integration if no new negative rises and genuine weak gains with no extra false/duplicate or known-positive loss. This is not a substitute for the independent R22 challenge.
